title: Why Do Some People Have Better Direction Sense?

cues.text: In July of 2025, top athletes competed in a kilometers-long race—
cues.en: In July of 2025, top athletes competed in a kilometers-long race—
cues.zh: 2025 年 7 月，一群頂尖運動員 參加了一項數公里的賽跑——

cues.text: but it had no set path.
cues.en: but it had no set path.
cues.zh: 但這場比賽沒有固定路線。

cues.text: That's because it was the World Orienteering Championships,
cues.en: That's because it was the World Orienteering Championships,
cues.zh: 當時舉行的是世界定向越野錦標賽，

cues.text: and participants equipped with only maps and compasses
cues.en: and participants equipped with only maps and compasses
cues.zh: 參賽者只攜帶地圖和指南針，

cues.text: were expected to find their way between far-off checkpoints at high speeds,
cues.en: were expected to find their way between far-off checkpoints at high speeds,
cues.zh: 必須一邊快速奔跑，一邊找出前往 相距甚遠的各個檢查點的路線；

cues.text: weaving between trees, sprinting over rocks, and skirting cliffs.
cues.en: weaving between trees, sprinting over rocks, and skirting cliffs.
cues.zh: 他們穿梭於樹林之間、飛奔越過岩石， 有時還得繞過懸崖峭壁。

cues.text: This might sound a little daunting.
cues.en: This might sound a little daunting.
cues.zh: 這聽起來有點令人望而生畏。

cues.text: But whether you identify as a wayfinding whiz
cues.en: But whether you identify as a wayfinding whiz
cues.zh: 然而，不論你自認是認路高手，

cues.text: or get lost returning from the grocery store,
cues.en: or get lost returning from the grocery store,
cues.zh: 還是連從雜貨店走回家都會迷路，

cues.text: your brain has a built-in navigation system that facilitates spatial skills,
cues.en: your brain has a built-in navigation system that facilitates spatial skills,
cues.zh: 你的大腦天生就具備一套導航系統， 幫助你發展空間辨識與定向能力，

cues.text: from sensing which direction is north to map reading and route learning.
cues.en: from sensing which direction is north to map reading and route learning.
cues.zh: 能夠辨認北方的方向， 閱讀地圖，並記住行進路線。

cues.text: It consists of two major parts: the striatum and the hippocampus.
cues.en: It consists of two major parts: the striatum and the hippocampus.
cues.zh: 這套系統主要由兩個部分組成： 紋狀體和海馬體。

cues.text: The striatum is clued into sensory inputs, like nearby landmarks.
cues.en: The striatum is clued into sensory inputs, like nearby landmarks.
cues.zh: 紋狀體會接收感官訊息， 例如附近的地標。

cues.text: With repetition, it comes to associate specific stimuli and actions
cues.en: With repetition, it comes to associate specific stimuli and actions
cues.zh: 經過反覆練習後， 它會將特定的刺激與行動，

cues.text: with certain responses and outcomes,
cues.en: with certain responses and outcomes,
cues.zh: 和某些反應及結果連結起來，

cues.text: linking these cues with set routes.
cues.en: linking these cues with set routes.
cues.zh: 把這些線索與固定路線建立關聯。

cues.text: This forms navigation habits;
cues.en: This forms navigation habits;
cues.zh: 這會形成固定的認路習慣；

cues.text: for example, when you automatically take the same sequence of turns
cues.en: for example, when you automatically take the same sequence of turns
cues.zh: 例如，你回家時會不假思索地 按照一模一樣的轉彎順序前進。

cues.text: on your way home.
cues.en: on your way home.
cues.zh: 相較之下，海馬體則在腦中建立 一幅幅連續而動態的環境地圖。

cues.text: The hippocampus, meanwhile,
cues.en: The hippocampus, meanwhile,
cues.zh: 相較之下，海馬體則在腦中建立 一幅幅連續而動態的環境地圖。

cues.text: constructs continuous, dynamic mental maps of your environment.
cues.en: constructs continuous, dynamic mental maps of your environment.
cues.zh: 相較之下，海馬體則在腦中建立 一幅幅連續而動態的環境地圖。

cues.text: It helps you figure out how to get somewhere,
cues.en: It helps you figure out how to get somewhere,
cues.zh: 幫助你找出前往某個地方的路線，

cues.text: even if you've never been or haven't taken that exact route before.
cues.en: even if you've never been or haven't taken that exact route before.
cues.zh: 即使你從未去過那裡，或從未走過 那條確切的路線，也能做到。

cues.text: Researchers realized the hippocampus’ importance in mental mapping in the 70s,
cues.en: Researchers realized the hippocampus’ importance in mental mapping in the 70s,
cues.zh: 1970 年代，研究人員在觀察 老鼠的大腦活動時，

cues.text: while observing rats’ brain activity
cues.en: while observing rats’ brain activity
cues.zh: 發現了海馬體在建構 環境空間概念上的重要性。

cues.text: and noticing that specific neurons in the hippocampus fired
cues.en: and noticing that specific neurons in the hippocampus fired
cues.zh: 他們注意到當老鼠身處 某些特定空間時，

cues.text: when the rats were in certain spaces.
cues.en: when the rats were in certain spaces.
cues.zh: 海馬體中的特定神經元就會發放訊號。

cues.text: The same thing also happened in complete darkness,
cues.en: The same thing also happened in complete darkness,
cues.zh: 即使在完全黑暗的環境中， 也會出現相同的情況。

cues.text: indicating that these neurons, which came to be called “place cells,”
cues.en: indicating that these neurons, which came to be called “place cells,”
cues.zh: 這顯示這些後來被稱為 「位置細胞」的神經元，

cues.text: formed cognitive maps independent of sensory input.
cues.en: formed cognitive maps independent of sensory input.
cues.zh: 能夠不依賴感官輸入， 在腦中形成認知地圖。

cues.text: It seems that activity in these areas during sleep
cues.en: It seems that activity in these areas during sleep
cues.zh: 研究顯示，在睡眠期間，

cues.text: represents a kind of place replay
cues.en: represents a kind of place replay
cues.zh: 這些區域的活動似乎也會重現 曾經歷過的位置資訊，

cues.text: as the brain consolidates spatial information.
cues.en: as the brain consolidates spatial information.
cues.zh: 讓大腦得以鞏固空間資訊。

cues.text: And in 2005, researchers discovered additional types of navigational neurons
cues.en: And in 2005, researchers discovered additional types of navigational neurons
cues.zh: 到了 2005 年，研究人員 又在海馬體周圍的區域

cues.text: in the region surrounding the hippocampus.
cues.en: in the region surrounding the hippocampus.
cues.zh: 發現了其他型別的導航神經元，

cues.text: This includes “grid cells,” which fire in a regular pattern as one moves,
cues.en: This includes “grid cells,” which fire in a regular pattern as one moves,
cues.zh: 包括「網格細胞」。

cues.text: providing the brain with a kind of internal coordinate system.
cues.en: providing the brain with a kind of internal coordinate system.
cues.zh: 為大腦提供一套類似 內部座標系統的機制。

cues.text: Together, the breakthrough discoveries that put place and grid cells on the map
cues.en: Together, the breakthrough discoveries that put place and grid cells on the map
cues.zh: 這些突破性的發現，不僅讓位置細胞 和網格細胞正式登上科學舞臺，

cues.text: earned the 2014 Nobel Prize.
cues.en: earned the 2014 Nobel Prize.
cues.zh: 也讓相關研究成果獲得 2014 年諾貝爾獎的肯定。

cues.text: But while the striatum and hippocampus form a navigation system
cues.en: But while the striatum and hippocampus form a navigation system
cues.zh: 不過，雖然紋狀體和海馬體 共同形成了一套導航系統，

cues.text: that allows our brains to adapt between strategies depending on the task,
cues.en: that allows our brains to adapt between strategies depending on the task,
cues.zh: 讓大腦能根據任務需求， 在不同策略之間靈活切換，

cues.text: we still struggle to find our ways.
cues.en: we still struggle to find our ways.
cues.zh: 我們還是常常會找不到路。

cues.text: In the absence of strong external cues,
cues.en: In the absence of strong external cues,
cues.zh: 在缺乏明確外部線索的情況下，

cues.text: people tend to make small errors that send them off course and into circles.
cues.en: people tend to make small errors that send them off course and into circles.
cues.zh: 人們很容易出現些微偏差， 逐漸偏離原本的方向，甚至繞起圈來。

cues.text: And generally, some of us find ourselves lost more often than others.
cues.en: And generally, some of us find ourselves lost more often than others.
cues.zh: 一般來說，有些人就是 比其他人更容易迷路。

cues.text: Most people can handle a striatum-centric, well-practiced route;
cues.en: Most people can handle a striatum-centric, well-practiced route;
cues.zh: 大多數人都能依靠紋狀體， 熟練地走固定路線；

cues.text: but those who lean more on hippocampus-forward self-orienting
cues.en: but those who lean more on hippocampus-forward self-orienting
cues.zh: 但那些更依賴海馬體 自行辨認方向的人，

cues.text: tend to stand out as navigators.
cues.en: tend to stand out as navigators.
cues.zh: 通常更擅長認路。

cues.text: Twin studies suggest that genetics account for around 60% of the variation
cues.en: Twin studies suggest that genetics account for around 60% of the variation
cues.zh: 雙胞胎研究顯示，

cues.text: in our navigation abilities.
cues.en: in our navigation abilities.
cues.zh: 這些能力似乎與一般智力無關，

cues.text: These abilities appear independent of general intelligence,
cues.en: These abilities appear independent of general intelligence,
cues.zh: 這些能力似乎與一般智力無關，

cues.text: suggesting that navigation is its own distinct cognitive skill.
cues.en: suggesting that navigation is its own distinct cognitive skill.
cues.zh: 顯示認路其實是一種獨立的認知技能。

cues.text: And crucially, research indicates that it’s one that can be practiced
cues.en: And crucially, research indicates that it’s one that can be practiced
cues.zh: 更重要的是，研究指出，

cues.text: and improved.
cues.en: and improved.
cues.zh: 這項能力是可以透過練習 來培養和提升的。

cues.text: Compared to people from suburban and rural areas,
cues.en: Compared to people from suburban and rural areas,
cues.zh: 與來自郊區和鄉村地區的人相比，

cues.text: those who grew up in cities—
cues.en: those who grew up in cities—
cues.zh: 在城市長大的人——

cues.text: especially ones with more uniform, grid-like layouts—
cues.en: especially ones with more uniform, grid-like layouts—
cues.zh: 尤其是在道路佈局較為整齊、 呈棋盤格狀的城市——

cues.text: appear to struggle more with navigating less ordered environments.
cues.en: appear to struggle more with navigating less ordered environments.
cues.zh: 似乎更難在較不規則的 環境中辨認方向。

cues.text: And in a 2010 study, rugby players and martial artists were blindfolded
cues.en: And in a 2010 study, rugby players and martial artists were blindfolded
cues.zh: 2010 年的一項研究中， 橄欖球選手和武術家被蒙上雙眼，

cues.text: and asked to navigate back to a starting point.
cues.en: and asked to navigate back to a starting point.
cues.zh: 要求他們找回起點。

cues.text: The rugby players, who train at much larger scales,
cues.en: The rugby players, who train at much larger scales,
cues.zh: 橄欖球選手平時 在更大的空間範圍接受訓練，

cues.text: did so with more directional accuracy,
cues.en: did so with more directional accuracy,
cues.zh: 因此辨認方向時更加準確。

cues.text: suggesting that the difference in their spatial training
cues.en: suggesting that the difference in their spatial training
cues.zh: 這顯示空間訓練上差異，

cues.text: improved their judgement across longer distances.
cues.en: improved their judgement across longer distances.
cues.zh: 可能提升了他們 在較長距離的判斷能力。

cues.text: London cab drivers, meanwhile, must learn what’s referred to as “the knowledge,”
cues.en: London cab drivers, meanwhile, must learn what’s referred to as “the knowledge,”
cues.zh: 另一方面，倫敦的計程車司機 必須學習所謂的「知識」，

cues.text: which consists of extensive routes and landmarks
cues.en: which consists of extensive routes and landmarks
cues.zh: 也就是熟記整座城市中 大量的路線與地標；

cues.text: across the city’s infamously complex maze of streets.
cues.en: across the city’s infamously complex maze of streets.
cues.zh: 倫敦街道的複雜程度可是出了名的。

cues.text: Those who successfully complete the training
cues.en: Those who successfully complete the training
cues.zh: 研究人員觀察到， 成功完成這項訓練的人，

cues.text: have been observed to experience significant hippocampal growth.
cues.en: have been observed to experience significant hippocampal growth.
cues.zh: 其海馬體有顯著增長。

cues.text: But the brain’s malleability can be a double-edged sword.
cues.en: But the brain’s malleability can be a double-edged sword.
cues.zh: 但大腦的可塑性，也可能帶來反效果。

cues.text: While GPS devices reliably get us around,
cues.en: While GPS devices reliably get us around,
cues.zh: 雖然 GPS 導航裝置能可靠地 帶我們抵達目的地，

cues.text: they lead to worse spatial reconstructions than verbal directions and paper maps do.
cues.en: they lead to worse spatial reconstructions than verbal directions and paper maps do.
cues.zh: 但與口頭指示和紙本地圖相比，使用 GPS 會讓我們對空間的重建能力變差。

cues.text: By allowing our brains to engage less actively with environmental cues,
cues.en: By allowing our brains to engage less actively with environmental cues,
cues.zh: GPS 讓大腦不必那麼積極地 處理環境中的線索，

cues.text: GPS may degrade the hippocampal navigation system
cues.en: GPS may degrade the hippocampal navigation system
cues.zh: 久而久之，可能會削弱 海馬體的導航系統，

cues.text: and impair our own internal sense of direction.
cues.en: and impair our own internal sense of direction.
cues.zh: 也損害我們自身的方向感。

cues.text: So, to help improve it,
cues.en: So, to help improve it,
cues.zh: 所以，如果想提升這項能力，

cues.text: you can try putting your GPS away on more familiar routes
cues.en: you can try putting your GPS away on more familiar routes
cues.zh: 你可以試著在比較熟悉的 路線上不用 GPS，

cues.text: and paying attention to distant landmarks.
cues.en: and paying attention to distant landmarks.
cues.zh: 並留意遠處的地標。

cues.text: Instead of using turn-by-turn directions,
cues.en: Instead of using turn-by-turn directions,
cues.zh: 不要只依賴逐轉彎指示，

cues.text: consider experimenting with a paper map and exploring new places on foot,
cues.en: consider experimenting with a paper map and exploring new places on foot,
cues.zh: 不妨試著使用紙本地圖， 並徒步探索新地點，

cues.text: since physical movement helps the brain encode spatial information.
cues.en: since physical movement helps the brain encode spatial information.
cues.zh: 因為實際的身體移動， 有助於大腦記住空間資訊。

cues.text: Then, with a little practice, the next time you get turned around,
cues.en: Then, with a little practice, the next time you get turned around,
cues.zh: 如此一來，只要稍加練習， 下次迷失方向時，

cues.text: maybe you can first look within yourself to find your way.
cues.en: maybe you can first look within yourself to find your way.
cues.zh: 也許你可以先依靠自己的 內在導航系統，找到正確的路。
